name: halo-search

frames.best_why: Frame 6 shows the field filled and the halo at its brightest, brightest pink ring around the bar.

tagline: A dark search box ringed by a soft pink aurora that brightens on focus.
summary: A rounded search field with a magnifier on the right, wrapped in layered blurred gradients. The halo shifts on hover and glows harder while the field has focus.
appearance: A wide, rounded dark input sits on near-black, with pale Search... text on the left and a rounded magnifier tile on the right. A soft pink and violet glow leaks out around its border.
behaviour: The glow drifts slowly at rest, swivels when the pointer enters, and flares to a brighter pink ring once the field is focused. Typing fills the bar while the halo keeps shifting.
demo_content: Placeholder Search... and the typed query aurora gradients.
search_phrases: dark search box with pink light
use_when: A dark hero or command area wants a search field that feels alive without extra UI.
avoid_when: The field width is fixed near 300px, and the glow is very dim on light backgrounds.
customise: Only className is exposed; the placeholder, field size, colours and glow layers are written into the component's style block.
weight_why: Several blurred gradient layers with CSS transitions; no script.

a11y.note: The input is focusable but labelled only by its placeholder, and the magnifier tile is a span that cannot be clicked.

issues: The magnifier is a non-interactive span, so it cannot be clicked or reached by keyboard.
The placeholder is the only label on the input.
polish_why: Lovely aura and a clean field, but the magnifier is fake and the width is fixed.
title: Halo Search
